soils.name: Alluvial Soil
soils.description: Rich in humus, potash, and lime. Highly fertile and suitable for a wide variety of crops. Found in the Indo-Gangetic plains.

soils.name: Black Soil (Regur)
soils.description: High in clay content, retains moisture. Rich in iron, magnesia, and alumina. Ideal for cotton cultivation. Found in Deccan plateau.

soils.name: Red and Yellow Soil
soils.description: Develops on crystalline igneous rocks. Reddish due to iron diffusion. Often less fertile but responds well to fertilizers. Found in parts of Odisha, Chhattisgarh.

soils.name: Laterite Soil
soils.description: Rich in iron and aluminum. Becomes hard when dry. Suitable for plantation crops. Found in Western Ghats, Eastern Ghats.

soils.name: Arid (Desert) Soil
soils.description: Sandy in texture and saline in nature. Low in moisture and humus. Requires irrigation. Found in Western Rajasthan.

soils.name: Mountain Soil
soils.description: Varies in depth and texture. Often loamy and silty. Rich in humus but can be acidic. Found in Himalayan region.

soils.name: Loamy Soil
soils.description: A mix of sand, silt, and clay. Good drainage and moisture retention. Considered ideal for most crops. Found across India.

soils.name: Clay Loam
soils.description: Higher clay content than loamy soil. Good nutrient holding capacity but can be heavy. Needs good management.
